updates.note: The previous promise regarding GL0034 is not mentioned in this call transcript.

new_promises.statement: Expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27.
new_promises.quote: On the guidance, we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.
new_promises.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi

new_promises.statement: Expect FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of sales.
new_promises.quote: We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
new_promises.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi

new_promises.statement: Expect the Organon acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.
new_promises.quote: We expect the acquisition to be completed in Q4 FY27.
new_promises.speaker: Dilip Shanghvi
